thread:
maya: Heads up — DeployBot raised a canary anomaly for v4.0.1: p95 latency +90ms. Change window for APAC promo opens in ~50m. DeployBot suggests auto-revert. Thoughts?

DeployBot: AUTOTRIGGER -> metric latency.p95(canary, app=chat) = +92ms (threshold 80ms). Recommended: rollback canary to v4.0.0. To override: `/deploy suppress-autorevert 5100004321 --reason 'promo-window'`

tom: What's the error rate? any customer-facing errors?

leah: No 5xx. Traces show higher lock contention on KV cache for short-chat flows after new batching tweak.

maya: We can't break APAC promo. Ops, can we do regional throttle/pin instead of global rollback?

ops_bot: SUGGESTION: apply traffic-slice to keep 90% on v4.0.1 and 10% on v4.0.0 in ap-northeast-1 for 30m: `/deploy traffic-slice --region ap-northeast-1 --slices 90,10 --models v4.0.1,v4.0.0`

tom: That reduces impact but keeps some users on new model. Risky for promo. If promo requires deterministic latency, we should pin the region to v4.0.0.

leah: Agreed. Pinning is safest. Pin command: `/deploy pin --model v4.0.0 --region ap-northeast-1 --until 2026-03-22T04:00Z --reason 'promo-stability'`

maya: Also need release-note blurb + CS note. Can someone draft?

cs_lead: I'll take CS note. Short message: "Temporary stability pin applied in APAC for promo. No customer data affected. Monitoring continues."

tom: Draft for release notes: "APAC region temporarily pinned to v4.0.0 due to observed tail latency increases with v4.0.1. Full rollout paused while we investigate KV cache interactions."

DeployBot: ACTION: pin applied in ap-northeast-1 to v4.0.0. Autorevert disabled for pinned region. Job: job/pin/5100004321

maya: Good. Now do we still want to rollback canary globally or leave it at reduced traffic?

leah: If we've pinned promo region, we can allow canary rollback to reduce overall noise. Rolling back canary now will revert 10 canary instances.

tom: I'm okay with targeted canary rollback. Use `/deploy rollback --target canary --to v4.0.0 --reason 'reduce-tail-latency'`

DeployBot: ACTION STARTED: rollback canary -> job/rollback/5100004321. ETA 90s.

leah: Monitoring dashboards; traces will be pulled into ticket INF-4123.

DeployBot: ACTION COMPLETE: rollback job/rollback/5100004321 finished. Canary p95 back to baseline. No rise in errors.

maya: Thanks. Follow-ups: Leah to run KV cache microbench, Tom to test batching config rollback in staging, Ops to keep pin until clearance. Assign owners and timeline.

cs_lead: CS updated. Marketing brief updated to say "pin applied; customer experience unaffected."

tom: Also adding a short note in #incident-archive with full commands and job IDs.

maya: Closing thread. If DeployBot re-triggers >2 times within 24h, escalate to on-call and execs.
